provenance.method: Totals are sums of per-round UFC Stats rows for this fighter. Rates use elapsed fight time from the recorded result (final round + clock), or rounds x 5:00 when no result exists.
provenance.coverage_note: Only bouts with UFC Stats round rows are included; coverage may be partial and these are not as-of model features.
